description: This PHP source file defines the 'WeeklyTimesheetPeriod' class within the OrangeHRM TimeSheetPeriod plugin, responsible for calculating weekly timesheet periods, setting their period data, and managing timezone conversions.

classes.name: WeeklyTimesheetPeriod
classes.description: Represents a weekly timesheet period, extending the base TimesheetPeriod class, with methods to calculate days in the period, set period details, and handle timezone conversions.

methods.name: calculateDaysInTheTimesheetPeriod
methods.description: Calculates and returns an array of date strings representing each day in the weekly timesheet period based on the current date and XML start date.

methods.name: setTimesheetPeriodAndStartDate
methods.description: Generates and returns an XML string defining the weekly timesheet period with the specified start day.

methods.name: getLocalTimezone
methods.description: Maps a client timezone offset to a timezone region name from a predefined list; returns false if not found.
